document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
After each day of lonely travel, you spread your tattered sleeping 
blanket on an anonymous rock, concerned only that it be dry. 
This one seems like any other.

Make a Science (Geology) roll: if you succeed, go to 428: if you fail, 
go to 513.
